reports.notes: Born-digital typed fillable form (index format 'text'); every figure is typed and fully legible. Office field reads 'County Commission Seat B' (index.csv 'County Commission Seat B' - exact agreement). Street address, phone number and signature are redacted upstream by the county; the printed city 'Provo, UT 84604' and the email survive. BOXES B, C AND F ARE COMPOUND STRINGS, not single amounts: each reads '168872.24 +Inkind 7670.68' - a cash figure plus a separately-labelled in-kind figure, transcribed whole rather than summed. (This is the same convention used by Corey Astill's 2026 filing, key 64c8b5f1, where the equivalent strings are clipped; here they are complete.) Observation offered without altering any value: the printed Balance at Close (17460.70) equals the cash figure 168872.24 minus Box D (151411.54), so the filer's close counts cash only. Cover prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov'.
